scope: Five bounded restart cases through four shell aliases compare native GNU with the immutable Rboxc candidate. DEBUG, ERR, RETURN, nested DEBUG and a self-directed INT handler execute only the fixed private plain script. The temporary variable case checks restart from a prefixed function call. Complete parent and child Valgrind summaries are required. Native findings remain baseline observations; this is focused ownership evidence, not full Bash acceptance.

results.name: bash:interrupt-restart
args: trap 'exec ./plain interrupt-handler' INT; kill -s INT $$; printf unreachable

results.name: bash:nested-debug-restart
args: set -T; trap 'trap "exec ./plain nested-debug" DEBUG; :' RETURN; f(){ :; }; f; printf unreachable

results.name: bash:temporary-function-restart
args: set -T; trap 'exec ./plain temporary-function' RETURN; f(){ :; }; VALUE=private f; printf unreachable
